oil.when: 2019, using the ENTER button and selector wheel on the steering wheel
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the service shown has been done).
Turn the power mode to ON without starting the engine.
Use the steering wheel controls to bring up the engine oil life on the Maintenance Minder screen.
Press and hold ENTER for about 10 seconds until reset mode appears.
Use the up and down arrows on the selector wheel to pick the item you had done, or All Due Items.
Press ENTER to reset it. Repeat for any other item you had done.
oil.note: Choose Cancel to leave without resetting.
